Riley: RCA posted for the 2026-03-20 inference degradation — https://intranet.redwood/rca/2315003333. Short: autoscaler + cache eviction interaction led to high cold-start latency for embeddings and text-gen.

Nora: Thanks. Can we highlight the 3 priority follow-ups at the top?

Riley: Done. Priority items: 1) Tune eviction to protect long-lived prefixes (owner: Nora, due 2026-03-26). 2) Autoscale warmup + staged probe (owner: Diego, due 2026-03-24). 3) Canary/playbook & alerts (owner: Sam, due 2026-03-25).

Diego: I'll scope the probe — leaning metric-driven probe with a 5-min fallback ramp.

Sam: I'll add alert rules: cache.miss_rate surge and instance.startup_latency. Also adding runbook steps to RCA.

oncall-bot: TIMELINE: 2026-03-20 02:10 UTC error spike; 02:18 autoscale; 02:22 eviction thrash; 02:48 partial mitigation; 03:05 recovery. Full timeline linked in incident doc.

Riley: Action list in RCA: Nora -> eviction config PR (dev->staging) by 2026-03-26; Diego -> autoscaler probe PR by 2026-03-24; Sam -> alerts + playbook by 2026-03-25; Riley -> schedule 1-week follow-up (2026-03-31 15:00 UTC).

Nora: PR started, will include perf thresholds and canary flags.

Diego: For local repro used: `wrk -t8 -c300 -d45s --latency http://staging-gen.local/generate`. Will post exact script.

Sam: Suggest composite alert threshold at 3x baseline; include immediate paging if sustained >5m.

Riley: Added rollout checklist and rollback commands to RCA. Owners please confirm when ready.

Nora: Confirmed. I'll add estimated blast radius and rollback note.

Diego: Prototype branch up, demo scheduled for tomorrow.

Sam: Will pair on first canary and monitor metrics.

Riley: Publishing complete. Please comment on the RCA with updates so we can close after the follow-up checkpoint. :thumbsup:
